observations.observation: Original sets all text in the browser-default Times New Roman (161 elements), with FontAwesome used only for icon glyphs. The AI-built page sets every element in a single sans-serif stack: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif (127 elements).

tags.value: changed: default times becomes helvetica sans stack

observations.observation: Both pages use 16px body text. Original leaves line-height at the browser default ('normal'); the AI-built page sets it to 25.6px (1.6).

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 16px normal becomes 16px 1.6

observations.observation: Original's h1 sizes are browser defaults: 32px, bold 700, Times, in default link blue. The AI-built hero h1 is 57.6px at weight 600 in white, wraps to two lines, and reads 'Your partner for business transformation', where the original hero headline reads 'Partners for Business Transformation'.

tags.value: changed: default blue h1 becomes large white two-line h1

observations.observation: Original has three h1s (the 'STG' logo, the hero headline, and 'STG' again in the footer) and no h2, so the outline jumps from h1 to h3. The AI-built page has exactly one h1, then one h2 per section (five, all 35.2px at weight 600), then h3s for sub-items.

tags.value: changed: multiple h1s and no h2 becomes structured h1 h2 h3

observations.observation: On the original, value pillars (Customer Centric, Experts, Innovators) and section headers (Portfolio, Who We Are, News) are all identical h3s, one of which is empty, and news headlines are h4s. The AI-built page separates the tiers: sections get h2 titles with eyebrows, pillars and sub-items get h3s, and news headlines sit in spans.

tags.value: changed: identical h3 tiers become separated h2 h3 tiers

observations.observation: The AI-built page puts a small, uppercase, letter-spaced, bold blue eyebrow label above each section heading (CORE VALUES AND APPROACH, ACCELERATORS, PORTFOLIO, WHO WE ARE, NEWS). Original has no comparable labels.

tags.value: added: uppercase letterspaced blue eyebrow above headings
added: wide-tracked uppercase eyebrow labels

observations.observation: Original's colors are browser defaults only: black text rgb(0,0,0), link blue rgb(0,0,238), visited purple, and no backgrounds. The AI-built page uses a navy, white, pale grey and mid-blue palette: navy rgb(14,34,56) backgrounds, dark slate rgb(27,39,51) text, accent rgb(47,128,200), and dimmed blue-grey rgb(195,207,219) text on dark sections.

tags.value: changed: browser default black and blue becomes navy and mid-blue

observations.observation: Original has no section backgrounds, so all content sits on one plain transparent/white page. The AI-built page alternates full-width navy, white and light grey bands: hero, grey featured strip, navy values, white accelerators, navy portfolio, white who-we-are, grey news, navy footer.

tags.value: changed: plain white becomes alternating navy white and grey bands

observations.observation: Original content sits in a single column flush left at the default 8px body margin, leaving most of the 1440px viewport empty. The AI-built page centres content in a 1060px column (x=190–1250) with a left-aligned edge.

tags.value: changed: flush-left column becomes centered 1060px column

observations.observation: Original uses no flex or grid (display_grid 0, display_flex 0), so every block stacks vertically. The AI-built page uses grid (8) and flex (12) for multi-column rows: three value columns, a two-column Accelerators split, two Who We Are columns, and three-part news rows.

tags.value: changed: stacked blocks become flex plus grid columns

observations.observation: Original is about 2237px tall, with irregular large vertical gaps that look like empty section space. The AI-built page is about 3172px tall, with uniform section padding of roughly 70–80px.

tags.value: changed: shorter page becomes much taller stacked page

observations.observation: Both pages use the text 'STG' as the logo, with no image logo. Original renders it as a 32px bold, blue, underlined h1 link. The AI-built page renders it as a letter-spaced wordmark at the left of a solid 64px navy header bar.

tags.value: changed: blue underlined h1 text becomes letterspaced wordmark in navy header

observations.observation: Original's primary nav is a run-together row of underlined default-blue links with no spacing ('Our ApproachPortfolioWho We AreNewsContact'), across 4 nav elements. The AI-built page has one nav: a spaced horizontal list of six text links at the right of the navy header, with no active-state highlight.

tags.value: changed: run-together underlined links become spaced right-aligned links in navy header

observations.observation: Both footers repeat the nav and include '© 2021 STG Partners, LLC' and 'Terms Of Use'. Original shows them as unspaced underlined links, with the copyright and 'Terms Of Use' jammed together. The AI-built page uses a single-row navy bar: copyright at the left, a 7-item link list at the right, in light blue-grey text.

tags.value: changed: unspaced links become single-row navy bar

observations.observation: Original shows small purple (visited-color) FontAwesome social icons (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, plus an @) under the nav and in the footer. The AI-built page has no social icons or icon font.

tags.value: dropped: footer and header social icons

observations.observation: Original's hero is just the headline, a one-line description and links, with no background or visual treatment. The AI-built hero is a full-width 1440×520 team photograph with a dark navy tint and white text plus an outlined button on top.

tags.value: changed: plain text hero becomes full-width tinted photo hero

observations.observation: Original has no photography: its imagery is six external SVG icons plus icon-font glyphs. The AI-built page has one photo (the hero PNG) plus six SVG icons, for seven images.

tags.value: changed: hero photograph alongside svg icons

observations.observation: Both pages have a featured announcement after the hero. Original shows it as a plain link reading 'McAfee Announces Sale of Enterprise Business to Symphony Technology Group for $4.0 Billion' with a blue FontAwesome plus glyph. The AI-built page puts it in a pale grey strip with a bold 'Featured:' lead-in, an inline time date, and a blue 'Read the announcement →' link.

tags.value: changed: plain link becomes grey strip with featured label

observations.observation: Both pages use the same six outline SVG icons (icn customer centric, growth, engaged and others) at varying natural sizes (39–110px). On the original they are left-aligned and near-invisible, white on white. On the AI-built page they appear white on the navy values section or inside small navy tiles.

tags.value: changed: invisible white icons become visible on navy tiles

observations.observation: All six original images are flagged alt-missing and the page has no aria attributes. The AI-built page has alt_missing 0: the icons carry an explicit empty alt as decorative images, the hero photo has a descriptive alt, and there are 2 aria attributes.

tags.value: changed: missing alts become descriptive and empty decorative alts

observations.observation: Both pages present the value pillars as an h3 plus a short tagline. Original stacks them vertically, interleaved with other sections. The AI-built page groups Customer Centric, Committed to Growth and Engaged Partners into a three-column row on navy, each column with an icon above.

tags.value: changed: stacked pillars become three-column icon row on navy

observations.observation: Neither page has button elements or forms (buttons 0): all calls to action are anchors. Original styles them as plain underlined links ('View Our Work', 'Read More', 'Learn more.', 'Our Approach'). The AI-built page styles them as square-cornered outlined ghost buttons (padding 10.64px 22.8px), white on navy or dark on white, with no filled primary button.

tags.value: changed: underlined text links become square outlined ghost buttons

observations.observation: Both pages repeat the generic link label 'Read More': six times on the original, and on all five news links plus Who We Are on the AI-built page. Neither puts the headline inside the anchor text.

tags.value: kept: generic read more link text

observations.observation: Original's Accelerators section is a stacked heading and text, with a 'Learn more.' link inline at the end of the body sentence. The AI-built version is a two-column split: a 506×240 navy block with a centred icon on the left, and the text on the right with a separate outlined 'Learn more' button.

tags.value: changed: stacked text becomes two-column icon block and text

observations.observation: On both pages the Portfolio section is text-only: a heading, a short line and a single link or button, with no portfolio logos or images.

tags.value: kept: text-only heading line and link

observations.observation: Original stacks Who We Are, Experts and Innovators vertically as h3s with taglines. The AI-built page sets Experts and Innovators side by side as two columns with icon tiles, and puts a single left-aligned 'Read More' button below them.

tags.value: changed: stacked h3s become two columns with icon tiles

observations.observation: Original's news list stacks each item vertically: a two-line date, a bold serif h4 headline, then a 'Read More' link. The AI-built list is a bordered ul of five rows separated by hairlines on grey, each a single line with a fixed-width date, a flexible headline span and a right-aligned blue 'Read More'.

tags.value: changed: stacked items become bordered single-line rows

observations.observation: Original shows news dates as an abbreviated month stacked over the day ('Jun' over '01') in plain text. The AI-built page writes them in long form ('1 June 2021') in small bold slate-grey semantic time elements.

tags.value: changed: stacked month day becomes long-form time element

observations.observation: Both pages are flat, with no decorative effects: every element has a 0px border radius (169 on the original, 127 on the AI-built page), and there are no box shadows, gradients, backdrop blur, animations or transforms.

tags.value: kept: square corners everywhere
kept: no shadows gradients or blur

observations.observation: Original has no transitions. The AI-built page has 4 transitions.

tags.value: changed: no transitions becomes few transitions

observations.observation: Original uses a header, 4 nav elements, 8 sections and a footer, with no main element. The AI-built page uses one header, one nav, one main, 5 sections and a footer.

tags.value: changed: many navs and sections becomes single nav and main

observations.observation: Neither page uses article, aside or figure elements, so news items are not marked up as articles on either page.

tags.value: kept: no article aside or figure elements

observations.observation: Both pages use custom class names with no Tailwind-style utilities (tailwind_like_fraction 0) and only a few inline style attributes. Original has 149 class uses across 57 unique names and 3 inline styles, in div-heavy markup (41 divs). The AI-built page has 45 class uses across 16 unique names, 5 inline styles and 26 divs.

tags.value: kept: heavy div markup becomes minimal markup

observations.observation: Original loads 27 scripts and 8 external stylesheets. The AI-built page has no scripts, no external stylesheets and a single inline style block.

tags.value: changed: many scripts and stylesheets become single inline style

observations.observation: Original's head carries Open Graph and Twitter card meta tags, msapplication-TileImage and a JSON-LD block. The AI-built page has only charset, viewport and description meta tags and no JSON-LD.

tags.value: changed: rich social and json-ld meta becomes minimal meta

observations.observation: The original html element has an empty lang attribute. The AI-built page sets lang='en'.

tags.value: changed: empty lang becomes lang en

observations.observation: Both pages use concise corporate private-equity copy with declarative taglines (for example 'Business builders with deep sector expertise') and no exclamation marks or em dashes. Original runs about 213 words with 1 emoji; the AI-built page runs about 275 words with none.

tags.value: kept: no emoji or em dashes
